Body.Content:
Admins will be able to configure more granular and advanced controls for managing external bots and their access to meetings hosted in their organization. Admins will be able to configure a list of external meeting bots which are allowed to join meetings hosted in their organization. Admins can also opt to block all other bots or let them be enforced into the currently available high friction lobby experience. The allowed bots will be treated like a regular external participant to the meeting and meeting policies will be enforced as appropriate.

GA date: January CY2027
